[BusMan247] Please. My old man’s Tiguan has had 5 gearboxes (including the original). It sounds like an exaggeration, it isn’t. It’s only 9 years old. The first 3 were with me, then when I got it replaced I gifted him the car. Thankfully, when it went again, Volkswagen did it under ACL (after they denied and I went to fair trade).
That’s the DQ500 I believe. Basically an RS3 gearbox. (profanity) joke. My sisters Polo- also bought brand new, that had the known problematic one. 7 speed dry. Piece of shit. We were driving to work over the harbour bridge in peak hour and it wouldn’t get out of first gear. She drove it back to Artarmon. For warranty work and sold it. And my golf R. Back in the day had MK VI, Valdez failed, gearbox failed couple of times, clutch packs.. that car probably had launch control 10 times in it life if not less.
The crazy thing is, otherwise, they’re a great steer and built really well for the money. Because of all the above , my wife swore us off VW for life. Hard to blame her.
Now you have Chinese reliability I guess. Despite the cars looking like swollen dolphins.

LNG is sold based on the world market price (with region playing a part). Nothing is 'gifted' away - Australia wouldn't be as wealthy as it is if they were. The lease of the port of Darwin to the CCP was a massive mistake and should be reversed. However, the Chinese don't control the port and what goes in and out of it. Sovereign control remains with the Commonwealth via Border Force, Quarantine and the AFP. The CCP makes money out of the operation but that's the extent of their 'control'.
